title: Ada and the Gravity
author: Astrid Okonkwo
blurb: Zephyrine Montrose, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
